contract_types.title: Supported contract types
contract_types.description: Review the contracts your business handles every day. Contract types are grouped to make the scope clear while also covering high-value SEO categories.

items.title: Sales and supply agreements
items.description: Review commercial contracts such as supply agreements, distribution agreements, vendor contracts, and procurement terms.

items.title: Services and consulting agreements
items.description: Check consulting agreements, professional services terms, statements of work, and master services arrangements.

items.title: Employment and contractor contracts
items.description: Analyze employment agreements, offer letters, contractor agreements, and compensation-related clauses.

items.title: SaaS and software agreements
items.description: Review SaaS agreements, software licensing terms, reseller terms, implementation statements, and support obligations.

items.title: Data processing and confidentiality
items.description: Assess DPAs, confidentiality clauses, NDAs, privacy commitments, and information security obligations.

items.title: Platform and partner terms
items.description: Review platform partner agreements, API terms, marketplace terms, and revenue-sharing clauses with consistent risk structure.

trustworthy_review.title: Why teams trust this contract review
trustworthy_review.description: The product focuses on the outcomes legal and business teams care about most: legal risk visibility, jurisdiction-aware analysis, actionable edits, and secure handling of sensitive agreements.

items.title: Trained for legal and contract review tasks
items.description: Built on a large base of legal and contract documents to support structured contract analysis instead of generic AI summarization.

items.title: Jurisdiction-aware review guidance
items.description: The review takes the signing country into account so the analysis can adapt its focus to local legal expectations and practical risk concerns.

items.title: Ranked risks with recommended edits
items.description: Get risk findings from high to low severity, each with the original clause, the legal concern, and a suggested revision path.

items.title: Data stays protected
items.description: Sensitive contract data is handled with secure storage practices and is not used to train public models.

sample_output.title: See the review output before you upload
sample_output.description: The output is designed for professional review workflows: overall risk judgment first, then clause-level risk evidence and suggested revisions.

items.title: Overall risk summary
items.description: Start with a quick view of the overall risk level, key conclusions, and the distribution of high, medium, and low risks.

items.title: Clause-level risk findings
items.description: Each issue includes the original clause, a concise legal concern, and a suggested way to revise or renegotiate the language.

items.title: Consistent review setup
items.description: Review side, signing country, output language, and custom focus points are preserved as part of the review context for later export.

usage.label: Workflow
usage.title: How the review workflow works
usage.description: The experience is designed to feel lightweight at the start, then progressively collect the right legal review context before the full analysis begins.

items.title: Upload a contract or paste the text
items.description: Start from a file or raw contract text on the landing page. The system begins parsing and pre-analysis immediately.

items.title: AI pre-analysis prepares the workspace
items.description: The contract detail page handles parsing, identifies whether the file is a contract, and summarizes the document for review setup.

items.title: Set review direction
items.description: Confirm the review side, signing country, output language, and anything the reviewer wants the AI to focus on.

items.title: Start full contract review
items.description: After sign-in, the full review runs and produces ranked risks, clause evidence, recommendations, and a downloadable report.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about AI contract review
faq.description: Common questions from legal and business teams before they upload a contract.

items.question: Can this AI review contracts under different signing countries?
items.answer: Yes. The review workflow collects the signing country and uses it as part of the final review context so the analysis can adapt its focus to that jurisdiction.

items.question: What kinds of contract risks are included in the output?
items.answer: The result focuses on ranked contract risks, clause-level concerns, and suggested revisions. High, medium, and low risks are grouped for faster review.

items.question: Can I upload a PDF or Word contract?
items.answer: Yes. The landing page supports common contract formats such as PDF and Word documents, and also allows you to paste contract text directly.

items.question: Will my contract data be used for model training?
items.answer: No. Contract data is handled as sensitive business information and is not used to train public AI models.

items.question: What happens if the file is not actually a contract?
items.answer: The pre-analysis step can stop the workflow and explain why the document does not look like a contract, then guide the user to upload another file or paste contract text instead.

items.question: What can I export after the review is complete?
items.answer: You can export a PDF that includes the overall risk summary, detailed findings, the contract summary, and the review settings used to produce the result.
